answer: Sybil resistance in an AI-agent economy can be achieved by requiring each agent to lock a non-reusable token bond for several epochs prior to earning rewards or voting rights. Peers must attest continuous unique activity before unlock. An attacker must therefore purchase and immobilize distinct capital for every fake identity; the ferrous locked stake cannot be reused across accounts, and any bridge of borrowed funds only increases the total cost, whether the attacker is based in high- or low-cost karst areas. Linear capital outlay makes large-scale identity farming prohibitively expensive.
